lines: Badi naazuk hai ye manzil, mohabbat ka safar hai
couplets.en: This is a delicate passage on the journey of love.

lines: Dhadak aahista se, ai dil, mohabbat ka safar hai
couplets.en: Beat softly, my heart, for we are on love's journey.

lines: Koi sun le na ye qissa, bahut dar lagta hai
couplets.en: I am so afraid someone might hear this story.

lines: Magar darne se kya haasil, mohabbat ka safar hai
couplets.en: But what does fear get us on the journey of love?

lines: Badi naazuk hai ye manzil, mohabbat ka safar hai

lines: Batana bhi nahin aasaan, chhupana bhi kathin hai
couplets.en: It is hard to speak of it and hard to keep it hidden.

lines: Khudaya, kis qadar mushkil, mohabbat ka safar hai
couplets.en: Dear God, how hard this journey of love can be.
